name: Composio
description: Slack, GitHub, Google, Microsoft 365, Jira, Zoom and about a thousand other apps through Composio, an outside service that signs in to them for you.
integration.summary: Signs in to Slack, GitHub, Google, Microsoft 365 and other apps for you, through its cloud
integration.example: Which apps can you connect through Composio?
via.about: {name} goes through Composio, an outside service. Signing in and every request go through Composio's cloud: the account's keys are kept there, not on your hub, and Composio sees what the agent reads and sends. It needs your own Composio account (free up to 100,000 calls a month). For triggers on the apps' events, when your hub has a public https address, the hub registers a webhook in your Composio project (a webhook you set up there yourself is never changed); otherwise the events come over Composio's realtime channel, which Composio calls internal and may change.

setup.key.title: Composio API key
setup.key.hint: Sign up at platform.composio.dev (free), then Settings → API keys → New key, and paste it here. It stays in your hub's vault.
